prompt:
Consider the following company information, reported as of 2026-05-21. Act as a equity research analyst.
| Return 3m            | +12.6% |
| Return 1m            | +5.3% |
| Return 1w            | +2.7% |
| Range position (63d) | 100% |
| 21d realized vol     | 27% |
| Last close           | 57.25 |
Based only on the above and knowledge predating 2026-05-21, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock. Choose exactly one label from: BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has exhibited strong positive momentum across all observed timeframes (3m, 1m, 1w), indicating robust upward price movement. The "Range position (63d)" at 100% suggests the stock is currently trading at or near its 63-trading-day high, often a sign of continued strength, especially when supported by recent positive returns. While 27% realized volatility suggests some price fluctuation, the consistent positive returns and high range position point towards continued upside.

DECISION: BUY
